purpose: Map runtime UI modes and cruise triggers to the fastest safe sensing path. This is an execution map, not a strategy source.

global_policies.detached_model_service_policy: not_used_in_product_runtime; host CLI agent supplies native multimodal response
global_policies.hard_visual_ocr_policy: scoped_roi_only_for_phase_economy, the explicit augment renderer-draft Quick OCR action, and diagnostic owned-augment panel inspection; no_fullscreen_ocr; active choice candidate and final-selection intake is structured-card user report only
global_policies.augment_quick_ocr_execution_policy: entering augment mode reserves the shared OCR lane before asynchronous mode setup and blocks admission of new periodic or stage-only HUD OCR jobs until mode exit; an already in-flight job may finish, then the foreground resident-worker request runs next with a bounded end-to-end choice-window budget measured from queue admission and a unique transport request identity per attempt; expired queued work is removed before Python execution; each uniquely matched exact-stage/tier row updates only its physical renderer-local slot; partial results remain reviewable and never auto-send or write canonical choice facts
global_policies.match_connection_attachment_policy: Match attachment and HUD field readiness are separate. A same-match fresh MuMu watcher payload with a positive source revision, explicit 4354 self-shop anchor, and non-empty shop proves that Runtime has entered the live match even when HUD OCR has not yet produced stage/economy. This attachment evidence never bypasses field-level HUD authority or S=1 own-board promotion gates.
global_policies.user_equipment_confirmation_policy: When a real item-dependent decision lacks trusted structured equipment, answer the user's strategy action first and mention the missing field when material. Canonical natural-language equipment updates are accepted only through the explicit Cruise match_fact_capture entry, whose hidden request kind authorizes Runtime-validated current-match writes; ordinary chat remains conversational context only. Store accepted facts as current-match user_confirmed_equipment with explicit provenance and an exact inner match_session_id, use them immediately, and do not relabel them as MuMu live_state or start visual matching after the required field is confirmed.
global_policies.structured_item_freshness_policy: Historical 4356/4357 command presence is source-health evidence only. A structured empty value may override current-match user confirmation only when that field has an explicit current_payload_observed marker; seen-ever must not masquerade as current authority.
global_policies.icon_matcher_policy: never run icon matching from periodic HUD/background sensing; 4357 remains the opportunistic primary structured left item rail source, and left_item_rail_roi_icon may run once only for an explicit user refresh/equipment request when 4357 is absent, or as an explicit conflict check; all matcher output remains fallback/validation candidates only
global_policies.opponent_board_policy: Opponent board unit sensing is not a product path. MuMu 4353 is own-unit candidate evidence only; S=2 must not create opponent unit facts.
global_policies.icon_candidates_promotion_policy: Live icon matcher outputs are validation/fallback candidates only. 4357 is the only structured source that may populate items.item_bench. left_item_rail_roi_icon must stay in items.item_bench_candidates as validation, fallback, or conflict evidence and must never populate items.item_bench, equipped_items, selected augments, opponent side rails, board/bench identity, or opponent board facts.

unit_attached_equipment_phase_gate.promotion_rule: Only assign 4356 visible equipment to own equipped_items when S=1 and a fresh non-empty 4354 shop anchors the view, then match coordinates to trusted own 4353 units. S=2 must never update own equipped items, never promotes own board/equipment, and never creates opponent unit facts.

same_icon_disambiguation_policy.notes: Some augments share the same icon across non-plus/plus/plus-plus or stage variants. Opponent side-rail icons may only identify the visual group; keep all possible IDs unless context makes one unique.

view_scope_policy.s1: S=1 is own actionable view evidence. Product own-board promotion requires S=1 plus a fresh non-empty 4354 shop anchor.
view_scope_policy.s2: S=2 means observing or non-self current view. It must not be bound to battle_state and must not update own board, own bench, or opponent board facts.
view_scope_policy.mumu_4353: 4353 is treated only as an own-unit candidate source. It becomes own board only under the S=1 plus fresh 4354 shop anchor gate.
view_scope_policy.mumu_4354: Non-empty 4354 shop is the strong own actionable view anchor. Empty 4354 is transition/observing evidence only.
view_scope_policy.mumu_4357: 4357 is the primary structured left item rail / item bench source.
view_scope_policy.mumu_4356: 4356 visible equipment rectangles may populate own equipped_items only when assigned by coordinates to trusted own 4353 units under the S=1 plus 4354 gate; otherwise keep as unassigned diagnostics.

mumu_structured_source_diagnostics.purpose: Classify missing structured item facts without retaining full raw logcat or promoting fallback icon candidates.
mumu_structured_source_diagnostics.retention_policy: Keep counters, payload-shape summaries, timestamps, process health, and at most a bounded set of equipment-like unparsed lines. Do not retain full raw logcat by default.
mumu_structured_source_diagnostics.item_source_policy: 4357 remains the only structured source that may populate items.item_bench. 4356 may populate equipped_items only through S=1 plus a fresh non-empty 4354 shop anchor and trusted 4353 coordinate assignment. Icon matches remain fallback evidence and may not be started by periodic HUD/background sensing.

structured_user_card_report_policy.input_surface: structured searchable decision card, not chat-composer prefill
structured_user_card_report_policy.refresh_policy: preserve every slot and let the user edit only candidates that actually changed; submit from the card
structured_user_card_report_policy.equipment_policy: shared token categories inherit across supported cards; omitted category preserves, explicit empty category clears, Backspace removes one whole token

round_tier_selector_sensing_policy.round_selector: manual UI selector writes current match phase fields as user-confirmed context; it does not run OCR and does not open a Host answer lane
round_tier_selector_sensing_policy.rank_tier_selector: manual UI selector writes runtime_user_settings.rank_tier; it does not mutate current match live_state or start sensing

cruise.ocr_policy: hud_phase_economy_small_roi_fast_path_only; scoped ROI only, no fullscreen OCR
cruise.icon_policy: 4357 primary for item_bench; left_item_rail_roi_icon is explicit-request fallback/validation only and never runs from periodic cruise HUD sampling; other icon assets are reference data for hard visual fields
cruise.self_state_dependency: Cruise may use own_board, own equipped items, and active traits only after the upstream self-state gate: visible 4354 shop self-view anchor plus fresh 4353 current-view evidence. Current_view units remain candidate evidence and must not be summarized as own_board.

choice_set_policy.source_conflict_policy: Choice windows seed the current visible set from current-match user reports. Previous or stale choice observations must not overwrite the latest current choice set.

post_reroll_followup_hook.state_policy: replace current_choice_set; retain previous_choice_sets as history evidence only

owned_augment_text_panel_roi.stage_binding_policy: fixed_augment_row_stage_binding: slot0=2-1 augment, slot1=3-2 augment, slot2=4-2 augment; ignore every non-augment row
owned_augment_text_panel_roi.cruise_policy: cruise must not consume this diagnostic as confirmed choice truth and must not trigger this ROI capture

icon_match.reason: Active augment candidates are reported by the user. Icon data remains catalog/reference context and is not a live choice matcher.

item_choice.own_state_dependency: own_board, own_item_bench, equipped_items, and active_traits consumed by item_choice must come from the self-state gate. Visible item options do not require self-view anchor, but holder/tempo evaluation must treat ungated current_view as candidate-only evidence.
item_choice.manual_trigger_policy: Manual only: user enters item_choice mode, reports the visible candidates, then sends. Cruise must not capture item/anvil/forge choice frames.
item_choice.scope_policy: Narrow product item mode to explicit user-reported item/anvil/forge candidate cards plus current effective equipment context; it is not an inventory scanner or hero/item reward three-choice intake.

numeric_authority_policy.missing_before_numeric_coercion: A null, undefined, blank, missing, unrecognized, or failed ROI field remains missing. It must never be passed through JavaScript numeric coercion where null could become zero.
numeric_authority_policy.requested_field_without_result: Every requested HUD field without an OCR result carries an explicit missing field_status plus bounded ROI diagnostics such as crop-task count and local-row/layout status.
numeric_authority_policy.same_frame_hud_anchor: A full HUD refresh must recognize phase.stage_round in the same captured frame before any economy ROI value receives self_state_roi_ocr authority. An isolated number from a loading, roster, reward, or transition screen remains diagnostic evidence and cannot be combined with a later stage-only observation.
numeric_authority_policy.field_level_promotion: After the same-frame HUD anchor succeeds, only fields with an accepted normalized value receive self_state_roi_ocr authority; valid sibling fields from that anchored frame still promote when one field is missing.
numeric_authority_policy.active_match_hp_zero: HUD HP less than or equal to zero is invalid/missing during an active match. Elimination requires separate explicit match-ended or elimination evidence.
numeric_authority_policy.persisted_invalid_cleanup: Hydration and failed-refresh paths remove previously persisted invalid HUD numeric fields and their source authority while preserving valid sibling economy facts.

refresh_self_state.production_policy: HUD refresh uses the daemon-owned RapidOCR worker only. Structured item facts are read from canonical live_state without starting visual work. One bounded item icon candidate refresh is allowed only for an explicit user refresh/equipment request or conflict check; it never promotes confirmed ownership.

icon_matcher_status.current_status: 4357 is the opportunistic primary product source for left item rail inventory, with trusted 4356-to-4353 assignment for equipped items. Current-match explicit user confirmation is the preferred fallback. left_item_rail_roi_icon is the last layer, runs only for an explicit user refresh/equipment request when 4357 is absent, and emits fallback/validation candidates only; it must not populate items.item_bench.
next_verification_needed: 4357 inventory payload real-frame coverage across normal/anvil/special item states
explicit-request left item rail icon matcher fallback when 4357 is absent or stale
